title: Threshold brightness
summary: Thresholding turns brightness values into two groups. A binary threshold sets values above the limit to a maximum and the rest to zero.
introduction: Thresholding turns brightness values into two groups. A binary threshold sets values above the limit to a maximum and the rest to zero. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Thresholding turns brightness values into two groups. A binary threshold sets values above the limit to a maximum and the rest to zero.

blocks.code:
import cv2
import numpy as np

gray = np.array([[50, 100, 150]], dtype=np.uint8)
_, binary = cv2.threshold(gray, 100, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY)
print(binary.tolist())
blocks.title: Threshold brightness

blocks.text: The output is [[0, 0, 255]]. Only 150 is greater than 100. A value equal to the threshold stays zero for this mode.
